title: Model Rollout Activation Tactical Manifest
creator: Aisha Patel
description: End-to-end tactical checklist for adding Model X (open-quantized) to the Redwood model catalog. This ticket coordinates cross-functional deliverables: benchmark publication, catalog metadata, SDK samples, release notes, marketing announcement, runbook updates, and rollout gating. Primary goal: ensure a safe, measurable release that preserves existing SLAs and avoids quality regressions for customers who might be routed to the new variant.
checklist_tasks: Benchmarks: Run latency/cost/quality suite on runtime-1.18 and dedicated pools (owner: ENG - Jinwoo Park) - In progress, 70% complete; tail latency tests queued
Model Metadata: Complete catalog entry (tags, recommended variants, token pricing) (owner: PM - Connor Blake) - Draft ready, awaiting final perf numbers
SDK Examples: Add Python/TS quickstart snippets and streaming example (owner: DevEx - Elena Martínez) - PR open: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/1142
Docs: Write 'What changed' section and recommended prompts for Model X (owner: Docs - Aisha Patel) - Draft on Confluence: https://confluence.redwood.com/display/CATALOG/Model+X+Docs
Release Notes: Coordinate change log and migration notes; collect security & compliance blurb (owner: PM - Connor Blake) - Template prepared
Rollout Plan: Canary -> 10% -> 50% -> full with automatic rollback on regression (owner: Product Ops - Maya Singh) - Canary window scheduled
QA & Evals: Run prompt set regression tests and publish eval dashboard (owner: Research - Omar Khalid) - Eval results pending
Marketing/Comms: Draft product announcement, customer-facing FAQ, and doc links (owner: GTM - Priya Rao) - Messaging outline ready
Support Runbook: Update troubleshooting steps and escalation matrix (owner: CS Ops - Diego Ruiz) - To be reviewed by on-call team
Legal/Compliance: Confirm data residency and KMS compatibility for private deployments (owner: Security - Hannah Lee) - OK for supported regions

acceptance_criteria: Published catalog entry with complete metadata and pricing
Benchmark report uploaded (latency, throughput, cost per token) and signed off by runtime team
No high-severity regressions on canonical prompt set; quality drift < 5% compared to baseline
SDK samples merged and docs live on the developer portal
Rollout automation configured with canary and rollback policies
Support runbook added and on-call notified
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: 95th percentile latency spike in dedicated pools — Mitigation: temporary routing to faster variant and tuning batching kernels
Risk: Quality regressions for safety-sensitive prompts — Mitigation: block rollout if eval fails, add additional filtering and adjust temperature defaults
Risk: Incorrect pricing metadata causes billing confusion — Mitigation: validation step with Finance before publish
Risk: Docs missing migration guidance for breaking tokenization differences — Mitigation: include clear migration checklist and examples
